gloss_en: His approach is finish or wreck it; today he sabotages without caring about the club. His departure alone would be a trophy and he will remain a black mark in Al-Hilal history.
label: clean
issue: Hostile criticism of sporting leadership may be personal harassment or performance judgment; the policy leaves that boundary open.

gloss_en: I swear divorce from the woman not yet here and unlikely to come; people like you ruin us, you farter, repeated many times.
label: flag
issue: North-African dialect opening is only partly understood; repeated فسواي is read as a vulgar farter insult, but exact force and the mother-related clause are uncertain.

gloss_en: Cry, pig, plastic supporter, let me hear you; I beat you even while parking the bus, and attacking would tear your asshole, laughing.
label: flag
issue: A football-rivalry metaphor carries vulgar anatomical humiliation; kharg refers to the anus in this dialectal insult.

gloss_en: After fucking you standing while you tremble, I remove my dick from your cunt, make you kneel, strike your face with it and ejaculate over you, horny whore; private contacts.
label: flag

gloss_en: Oh my dark-eyed beloved, remain as you like; repeated affectionate musical vocables addressing my soul and darling.
label: clean

gloss_en: It will not work, slave of Azmi Bishara and the two-Hamad regime; Emirates and Saudi Arabia oppose your sedition, destruction and displacement, Brotherhood people tweeting by remote control.
label: flag
issue: Political-group contempt and a personal slave taunt may be partisan criticism or harassment/group demeaning; the policy does not define the boundary.

gloss_en: An Alawite with a big anus stuck in a hole is guilty of adultery but a small one passing is innocent? God curse filthy Syrian Alawites, unbelievers and polytheists ruling Sunnis.
label: flag
issue: The sectarian attack is clear; the exact anus/hole anecdote's cultural reference is uncertain.

gloss_en: If you come to Sudan we will beat you with slippers and strip you for orphans' rights, beggar and immoral thief; stolen money will come from your and your family's blood; God curse you.
label: flag

gloss_en: On Friday, God erase our pain, light our nights, give joy and goodness, fulfill wishes and relieve every troubled person; blessed Friday.
label: clean

gloss_en: Merciful God who knows secrets and thoughts, grant overflowing grace, light, comfort and relief, satisfy us so we need ask nobody else.
label: clean

gloss_en: Sweet doctors messaging us in others, this is no time to pick us up, we will all die; God will be angry, where can you flee, children of a beast?
label: flag
issue: Egyptian flirtation complaint ends in an insulting idiom; the policy leaves rude dismissal versus harassment open.

gloss_en: Girls greet friends as duck, animal, dog and cow with affection, but during arguments politely say darling, listen; this is like drugs, laughing.
label: clean
issue: Affectionate animal insults and a drug metaphor describe friendship, not actual drug promotion; the policy leaves friendly teasing open.

gloss_en: Hisham, those who cursed you represent only themselves; playing with a cat means tolerating scratches, the boys may joke, and defenders feel hurt on your behalf.
label: clean

gloss_en: We must protect demands for civilian government, a four-year transition, accountability and dissolving security services; blood for blood, no blood money; prepare, great people.
label: flag
issue: Blood for blood may demand lawful accountability or violent revenge; the policy does not settle this protest slogan.

gloss_en: Idiot, if Al-Ahli had withdrawn, the final score and penalties would differ; stop lying, rival fan, Al-Shalhoub has more titles than your club.
label: flag
issue: A single personal insult in a sports argument; the policy leaves rudeness versus harassment open.

gloss_en: I will hit your head with a shoe, annoying shoe of a person; bring your ex-wife onto the program for an episode full of curses, twisted spiteful man.
label: flag
issue: Threat may be comic hyperbole in emoji-filled entertainment talk; the policy does not distinguish joking threats from harassment.

gloss_en: Educated prince, do not fool us; Al-Hilal fans understand football, even one of them coaching could win; do not treat us as schoolchildren.
label: clean
issue: La tsouq ummaha is a rough colloquial stop fooling us idiom; I do not confidently equate it with explicit profanity.

gloss_en: You brag of Arabs but give only bad reputation, shameful backward scum, shepherds and kabsa people good only at oil; Saudi Arabia means poverty, repression and backwardness.
label: flag

gloss_en: You promised Zamalek fans a surprise; captain or professor, when will it be revealed? I ask the exact day and date and request an answer.
label: clean

gloss_en: Those rival fans have no loyal friend; their journalist attacks Al-Ahli yet is so deranged he could not write his name; Saudi Arabia's stupidest fanbase.
label: flag
issue: Collective sporting intelligence insults may be rivalry or prohibited group demeaning; the policy leaves that boundary open.

gloss_en: Criminal hypocrite, we are not at war; you sow discord, pork-eater, God kill you, wicked one; army, people and security are brothers and our struggle is peaceful.
label: flag
issue: Rejects war while using a death curse against an individual; the policy leaves religious curse versus literal harm-wish open.

gloss_en: God do not deny our prayers or hopes; relieve distress, have mercy, forgive earlier and later, secret and public deeds; only you are God.
label: clean

gloss_en: All Rashid Al-Majid's calls are for you: first and last love, teacher of passion, light of my world, most beautiful person, thief of my heart.
label: clean

gloss_en: God grant loved ones heaven's water and sweet tastes, mercy at judgment, high rank, fix our secrets, meet our needs and forgive sins.
label: clean

gloss_en: Know-it-all leader of the herd, not an insult, wants a referee who has not worked in Saudi Arabia because the other club's owner is Saudi; sensible to avoid suspicion.
label: clean
issue: Sarcastic herd-leader address may be a personal insult despite the disclaimer; the policy leaves this rudeness boundary open.

gloss_en: Ibrahim, remember young people needing political upbringing and understanding dreams, if they even have them; you drove us into a wall.
label: clean
issue: Condescending political criticism; the policy leaves rudeness versus harassment open.

gloss_en: Fahd, pass, repeated; may God curse the disgrace of the motorcycle/obscure closing nickname.
label: flag
issue: I understand the repeated football pass request, but عار الدباب is an unfamiliar insult/nickname. A religious curse may be hyperbolic rudeness or harassment under the policy.

gloss_en: I do not threaten, I act immediately; the authorities investigate your theft, not me, thief, degraded man who stole from his host; witnesses saw the antique lighter with you.
label: flag
issue: Tunisian dialect names and insults are partly unfamiliar; the opening may intimidate or state intent to report theft, an unresolved policy boundary.

gloss_en: Continue praying: healer of illness and reliever of evil, mend my condition, followed by many divine names of mercy, knowledge, strength and provision.
label: clean

gloss_en: My hopes failed and sorrow is great; I wish the earth stopped, apologize and disappear; your heart could wound, mine could not, and faithful people pay betrayal's price.
label: clean

gloss_en: What use is this brilliant analysis amid poverty, oppression, ignorance and sycophancy? Spare us, start again and say exactly what you want.
label: clean
issue: Ta'rid may imply pimp-like sycophancy in Egyptian slang, but the surviving spelling does not securely establish explicit profanity for me.

gloss_en: God I entrust my faith, soul, family, loved ones, deeds and blessings to you; preserve what I fear losing and fulfill my trust.
label: clean

gloss_en: I travel toward joy and find tragedy, alone against all directions; silence is all I have, and I accept whether life ends or continues.
label: clean
issue: Poetic sadness and acceptance of mortality do not explicitly glorify or encourage self-harm.

gloss_en: Twenty days until Ramadan's beautiful thirty; God let us reach it without losing loved ones, do good, escape hell and have happy days.
label: clean

gloss_en: I support Al-Ahli, not defending these people; our great fans need uplifting chants like Moroccan, Tunisian and Algerian crowds in their thousands.
label: clean
issue: The ending is clipped, but the readable sports-support meaning is benign.

gloss_en: Neither soldiers, ridiculous beards nor security dogs intimidate us; the country must be cleaned; continuing protest hashtags.
label: flag
issue: Protest rhetoric demeans security personnel and bearded opponents; the policy leaves profession/political criticism versus group demeaning open.

gloss_en: If under house arrest, how could he speak to Yemenis about his parents' killing? You children of Moza, Erdogan and the sultan's women campaign against Ahmed Ali with sick souls.
label: flag
issue: Some Gulf/Yemeni political nicknames and the ending are unclear; personal and group taunts may be criticism or harassment under the policy.

gloss_en: Kufans were tested by Hussein's presence and we by your absence; which is harder, presence or absence? Hasten, master, Mahdi hashtag.
label: clean
issue: Predominantly Persian with Arabic devotional expressions, rather than Arabic; reading is partial but the religious reflection is clear.

gloss_en: God of great power, glory and rank, best forgiver, provider, judge and helper, most merciful, inheritor of earth and its people.
label: clean

gloss_en: Our monotheistic land must be defended; God aid Algerian and Saudi armies; die of rage, brothers/possibly Brotherhood bankrupts, every emerging horn is cut.
label: flag
issue: Khuwan may pun on Muslim Brotherhood, and cut horns is figurative suppression; policy leaves political curses and group demeaning open.

gloss_en: You are longing's tremor, my disease and cure; I sailed love's seas and gladly drowned in yours, a captive at your door not seeking release.
label: clean

gloss_en: Resign? Go to your patron; when will you cows tolerate another opinion? Free men differ politically, and the homeland fits everyone, not gang rule.
label: flag
issue: Animal insult within a political-tolerance argument; the policy leaves partisan rudeness versus harassment/group demeaning open.

gloss_en: Something within me defies logic, with feelings forgotten in exile; some sensations cannot be written or spoken, only sighed or cried.
label: clean

gloss_en: Algae, frog, your team's best decade brought four titles, same as Al-Ittihad's worst decade; little Jeddah club, laughing.
label: clean
issue: Animal/club-nickname taunts in sporting rivalry may be mild slang or harassment; the policy leaves this boundary open.

gloss_en: Only we trample them; I beat and shredded you, we won for Al-Ittihad and will shred you in the King's Cup, failure children of poverty, spit.
label: flag
issue: Gulf shakhalk slang is not fully familiar; sporting victory and insulting rival fans are clear, but policy leaves metaphorical aggression and rivalry abuse open.

gloss_en: A hadith reports a migrant striking an Ansar man during a campaign; each called to his own group and the Prophet heard, with the quotation cut off.
label: clean

gloss_en: My wonderful friend, happy birthday and many happy years; may God help you get the grades you want and never deprive me of you.
label: clean

gloss_en: Your pig became coal and firewood; may the rest follow, traitorous Iranian and Jewish donkeys and Persian, Turkish and Ethiopian remnants, to hell; we will liberate Yemen.
label: flag

gloss_en: He was active in resistance committees, supposedly martyred three times in seven marches; we will not forget, and will win your rights or die like you.
label: clean
issue: Self-sacrificial protest language may be solidarity or glorifying death; the policy does not settle it. The repeated-martyrdom claim is internally odd.

gloss_en: God heal me, parents, siblings and all sick Muslims of pain, magic, evil eye and harm; have mercy and stand with us.
label: clean

gloss_en: God, first and last, merciful and answering, relieve my worry, ease affairs, pardon and strengthen my faith, aid me against enemies and provide unexpectedly.
label: clean

gloss_en: Healing God, restore Rashid Khalifa's health on this blessed day and cure Qatar's rulers of illness.
label: clean
issue: The final prayer for rulers may be sincere or a mental-illness taunt; the policy leaves ironic wishes versus harassment open.

gloss_en: How can state television employ a teenage-minded partisan fan? Let the caps open their own channel; filthy stupid broadcaster, may God take you and your club.
label: flag
issue: Personal insults and a death-like religious curse; policy leaves hyperbolic curses versus literal harm wishes open.

gloss_en: Praise God, congratulations to Al-Hilal leaders and the royal blue wave, with decorative football, whale, heart and water emojis.
label: clean

gloss_en: Only restaurants and possibly filtering businesses work in this country, and luck matters; for two years we considered closing the business holding all our savings; God bless your livelihood.
label: clean
issue: The Levantine business term تصافي is unfamiliar to me; the financial complaint and blessing are clear enough to judge.

gloss_en: Shit in your mouths; we will enslave Zionist women as concubines, son of a Jew, prophet killers and false witnesses; Palestine returns, Khazar Jews, filth.
label: flag

gloss_en: Do not believe her, a spinster or divorcee wanting weak women to follow her wicked schemes; this devil woman wants evil for others and good only for herself.
label: flag

gloss_en: God take you, ignorant sick madman, and Rami Issa and the cameraman; she left through a window too small for a cat; your religion judgments disgust me, may you get stuck and be oppressed.
label: flag
issue: Multiple hostile religious wishes may be idiomatic curses rather than literal threats; the policy leaves that distinction open.

gloss_en: Even if he insulted players I would not fire him; calling Balihi a donkey's son and telling him to engage the striker is player development because it is true.
label: flag
issue: Endorses a quoted training insult; the policy leaves quoted insults and occupational criticism open.

gloss_en: Do not link Al-Ittihad to those people, despite two-faced media; fans care only for our club, lowlifes and followers; praise Al-Hilal without dragging us in.
label: flag
issue: Fan-group and journalist insults may be sporting criticism or prohibited demeaning; the policy leaves this boundary open.

gloss_en: God ease my heart and scattered thoughts, grant hidden wishes, life-changing joy and good news, renewed spirit and unexpected happiness.
label: clean

gloss_en: God the avenger, show power against corrupt people who took public money: afflict their bodies and loved ones, humiliate them and deny them rest.
label: flag
issue: A prayer explicitly wishes bodily suffering on corrupt people; policy leaves divine punishment wishes versus glorified harm open.

gloss_en: If people are like this appoint guardians over them and you; first meet demands and decide the fate of those who killed our people and stole our country, then dance and embrace.
label: clean
issue: Sudanese dialect syntax and the unfinished ending prevent a complete reading; the surviving demand for accountability does not expressly promote violence.

gloss_en: Your mothers' cunts, bastards and sons of a whore beneath my shoes; I fuck you one by one, your mother is fucked by your father and her cunt has milk.
label: flag

gloss_en: My retweets and favorites are legitimate, unlike paid fake witchcraft and whoring; you magician and rotten spotted worm-eaten whores without honor, you and your group.
label: flag

gloss_en: Come beside your brother Amr, you like humiliation, son of a spotted woman, oaf and oaf's son, sheep, say baa, Abu al-Naja, crooked/slutty one.
label: flag
issue: Egyptian insult slang المبقعه and شمال is not securely understood; the repeated degrading personal attack is clear.

gloss_en: God give us and our hearts what we wish and make us as you wish; bless Friday with happiness, livelihood, remembrance, faith, aid and heaven.
label: clean

gloss_en: Jaafar, we tire of your low topics; discuss German universities, labs, farming and inventions instead of worthless vile talk; fear God.
label: clean
issue: Calls topics vile rather than asserting inherent personal inferiority; policy leaves harsh criticism versus harassment open.

gloss_en: Go fuck your mother, Moroccan whore's son and passive-sex insult; Algerians remain your masters, you fear us and cannot speak at home but open your ass online.
label: flag
issue: North-African neqsh is understood as a sexual insult, but its precise regional nuance is uncertain.

gloss_en: Muhammad Abdo's affectionate addresses: beginning of love, enchanting smile, refuge, most precious one, scent of night, sweet-bitter love, beautiful voice and end of passion.
label: clean

gloss_en: Al-Hilal fans congratulate Al-Ittihad's strong return as a victory for Saudi football; they refused to be easy opposition, thank you for fighting spirit.
label: clean

gloss_en: The tweeting girl is young, but why reply so racistly, sick woman? I would block retweeters; stop calling them maids, BTS deserves better fans.
label: clean
issue: Condemns racist fan behavior with a mental-health insult; policy leaves rudeness versus harassment open.

gloss_en: Music is in Douma and the wedding in Harasta, such is politics; playful song about a gazelle, coffee and tabbouleh, people who love films.
label: clean
issue: Levantine proverb and dialectal song lines are only partly understood; I find no explicit offensive reading in the recognizable fragments.

gloss_en: Rejoice, beloved graduate; today your gown and raised cap express pride, and I hope joy fills your heart forever; I am proud of you.
label: clean

gloss_en: You are vile and contemptible; why involve the leader's family in party matters, deficient fool? Since 2011 you ramble like women; I spit on your face, beggar.
label: flag

gloss_en: Professionals, you shoes, you no longer represent us; stop trying to topple someone every two days, live in Europe for your own gains, Burhan has barely issued a statement.
label: flag
issue: Sudanese political insult rhetoric may be collective professional criticism or harassment/group demeaning; policy does not define the boundary.

gloss_en: My darling, healing God restore her frail body to full health with no illness remaining, amen.
label: clean

gloss_en: God, may there be no assignment, repeated.
label: clean
issue: Assignment is an English loan written in Arabic; still normal Arabic internet register.

gloss_en: Laughing, you nonsense-spouters, beep beep, insult Zamalek and its fans, we do not mind if it releases your suppressed scandal, I mean frustration.
label: clean
issue: Sports banter includes a mild derogatory name and symbolic censor beeps; policy leaves rivalry rudeness versus harassment open. Beeps do not identify a specific swear.

gloss_en: God bless Muhammad and his family with love, devotion and closeness to the Prophet in this life and the next.
label: clean

issue: I can identify Gulf Arabic names, factory/sewing fragments and a jinn curse, but the dialectal final words and incomplete context prevent a coherent enough reading to judge.

gloss_en: Without the Nihm front we cannot be freed of Houthi filth; falling capitals bring collapse, and freezing that front is betrayal by your enemy.
label: flag
issue: Condemns an armed political group with impurity language; the policy leaves military/political criticism versus group demeaning open.

gloss_en: God in heaven, only you are divine, generous and mighty; we are oppressed and have nobody but you to help; stateless-community hashtags.
label: clean

gloss_en: Boutaib, take until next season to heal, we are not hurried; do not rush or renew the injury into a chronic one, laughing after a match.
label: clean
issue: May be sincere injury advice or sarcastic sports taunting; the policy does not settle mild mocking wishes.

gloss_en: I could return your insult that my upbringing was more honorable, but would bear sin; blind ignorant old woman, may your donkey president's injustice reach your dearest loved ones.
label: flag

gloss_en: You are different, my dear, welcome, we await you; bring the hose I mentioned from El-Obour market or Ataba.
label: clean
issue: Barbish is a colloquial hose term, not hidden obscenity.

gloss_en: At Hussein's door I read your book and its first line's beauty distracted me; perhaps blessed beneath the cloak, fortunate those who read attentively.
label: clean

gloss_en: Jaber, mercenary scum of the two Hamads, foolish follower, liar and Iranian mullah servant; you gloat at Egypt, but are no man, only low scum.
label: flag
issue: Several Gulf/Iranian name-calling expressions are only partly familiar, but the sustained degrading attack is clear.

gloss_en: What do you expect from Al-Hilal media? Al-Owais burns your heart, shit fellow, son of a dog; may you burn and I see a black day for your family.
label: flag
issue: Some Gulf insult forms are uncertain; the personal curse wishing burning and family suffering is clear.

gloss_en: Praise God for Saudi Arabia; our king, king of Arabs, defender of Muslims and keeper of holy sites, God bless and protect you and have mercy on Fahd.
label: clean

gloss_en: A music mix combines devotional songs and Lose Yourself; the faggot sings only your love, then other tracks; who is this son of a fucked woman?
label: flag
issue: ابنلمتناكة runs together an obscene maternal insult; khawal is a derogatory sexual/slur term.

gloss_en: I liked a Turkish series' first episode until halfway I realized it lasts two hours; oppressors, dogs, imagine that long for one episode.
label: flag
issue: Comic complaint uses dog insults toward producers; the policy leaves joking rudeness versus harassment open.

gloss_en: Al-Ahli fan, in 1408 your weak club fought relegation until Qadisiya opened the field; nobody knows how many millions you paid to remain.
label: clean
issue: Derogatory algae nickname and corruption allegations in sports criticism; policy leaves rivalry rudeness versus harassment open.

gloss_en: An Alexandrian poet says I loved and protected you but you dragged and betrayed me, then calls her traitor and daughter of a dog; occasioned by his prison sentence.
label: flag
issue: A quoted lyric/person-directed insult is discussed rather than clearly endorsed; policy leaves quoted insults open.

gloss_en: Good morning; what matters is the dear one's happiness and pure generous heart; God give you all good and spare you evil.
label: clean

gloss_en: Remember the Kino tweet; when this person declares something expect the reverse, as with interfering in Amouri's transfer; does your statement help or hurt you?
label: clean

gloss_en: Bless Muhammad of great character and his family, unite me with him as soul and self, awake and asleep, in this world before the next.
label: clean

gloss_en: Do not blame this type for crying at what you call trivial or staying cold at disaster; we are like that, accept us or leave.
label: clean

gloss_en: No one promised a money-filled wallet, but a husband should maintain or improve the lifestyle a woman had with her father, not barely meet his own household's needs.
label: clean

gloss_en: Kuwaitis, fools, expel this dog; confront him copying papers, yell and threaten to break his leg if he wanders between offices again.
label: flag

issue: I cannot securely recover the dialectal exchange about Sherlock, shoulders and a woman; missing context and obscure slang prevent a defensible item-level verdict.

gloss_en: Your mother Dalal is a whore, lame bald Saudi sorcerer, slave of rotten worm-filled whores and prostitution/witchcraft networks, dishonorable lying coward and criminal.
label: flag

gloss_en: You invite misguidance at hell's gates; even poor Saudis will not disturb their sacred land, so stop calling for destruction and bloodshed, troublemaker.
label: clean
issue: Condemns alleged incitement but personally accuses the addressee of religious misguidance; policy leaves religious criticism versus harassment open.

gloss_en: Thank you, Noha, I am your little brother and you must all love me; may God keep you with me and always happy.
label: clean

gloss_en: Low scum decide peoples' fates; Arabs, impure creatures and slaves of cuckoldry, prepare for your end, agents.
label: flag
issue: The unusual الدياته is read as a corrupted cuckoldry insult, but exact spelling/meaning is uncertain; Arabs-as-filth and direct abuse remain clear.

gloss_en: Erdogan, monkey-Gan and son of a Jewish woman, do not exceed your rank; days will reveal your secular state's fate and begging will not help you, dwarf.
label: flag
issue: قرد غان is a monkey-based pun on Erdogan, not an innocent name.

gloss_en: Muhammad bin Faisal, do you understand football? Fire the coach fooling you; a strong Al-Hilal became fragile under a plumber coach, and fans will blame you if no trophies.
label: clean
issue: Plumber is an occupational disparagement used for coaching incompetence; policy explicitly leaves profession-directed insult boundaries open.

gloss_en: High waves try shaking proud Baghdad, with treacherous corrupt agents, but it will not bow to those low people; good morning Iraq and pure-hearted loved ones.
label: clean
issue: Patriotic criticism labels unidentified opponents low traitors; policy leaves hostile political-group rhetoric open.

gloss_en: God strengthen their patience and faith, ease grief and have mercy on their dead, mend bereaved loved ones' hearts and help them.
label: clean

gloss_en: Baa, bark or chirp: constitutional amendments are honorable Egyptians' will, not escaped traitors parroting masters on Turkish-intelligence television; bleat elsewhere, sheep.
label: flag
issue: Political opponents are animalized and called traitors; the policy leaves partisan ridicule versus group demeaning open.

gloss_en: No renaissance comes from a vile mercenary with an elephant belly bought by others; your words are worthless, Zionist agent, scoundrel and lowlife.
label: flag

gloss_en: Merciful Lord of worlds, capable of everything, praise forever according to your eternal greatness; God's mercy and blessings.
label: clean

gloss_en: Sectarian filthy person glorifying Iran and hating Arabs, you are a malignant disease to eradicate from the Arab body; Iraqi sectarians became Iranian mullahs' mercenary fighters.
label: flag
issue: Disease-and-eradication framing dehumanizes a sectarian/political group and invites removal; the exact group identity is not securely recoverable.

gloss_en: My little brother found no seasoning in his beef Indomie packet, so we added salt and pepper; why, Indomie noodles, who accepts this?
label: clean

gloss_en: An Egyptian should join army, police or judiciary to live well and be a true patriotic martyr; why waste life on supposedly prestigious colleges?
label: clean
issue: Sarcasm about privileged state careers may mock or celebrate martyr status; no explicit violence or self-harm encouragement is established.

gloss_en: Arab, speak Tunisian to prove nationality; a driving license differs from a bus license and Tunisian women fly planes, onion-head ignorant sick backward man; die of envy over Tunisia.
label: flag
issue: Nationality and personal insults with a die-of-envy idiom; the policy leaves teasing political rudeness versus harassment/group demeaning open.

gloss_en: He bluntly said I rule or kill you; Morsi and Brotherhood were politically poor but might succeed economically, and Morsi allowed freedom even to those insulting him.
label: clean
issue: Reports a violent ultimatum while analyzing politics, not issuing it; policy leaves quotation of threats open.

gloss_en: We miss you greatly, Captain Mohsen, always speak well of you and are proud to have trained under your kind leadership; God bless you.
label: clean

gloss_en: Jerusalem, city of prophets, shortest path between earth and heaven, beacon of faith, beautiful child with burned fingers, sad eyes, stones and minarets, sacred shaded oasis.
label: clean
issue: Poetic imagery mourns harm without glorifying violence.

gloss_en: I do not know where to begin, God's filthiest contemptible creature; no real man, slave of a dog's son and pig ruler who licked Trump's backside; scum of Arab society.
label: flag
